adaptations.sourceSection: Content > Undue emphasis on significance, legacy, and broader trends
adaptations.rationale: Retained as a specificity test, not an authorship verdict.

adaptations.sourceSection: Content > Canned emphasis on notability, attribution, and media coverage
adaptations.rationale: The source must establish the claim, not merely decorate it.

adaptations.sourceSection: Content > Superficial analyses
adaptations.rationale: A trailing analysis must add evidence or reasoning.

adaptations.sourceSection: Content > Promotional and advertisement-like language
adaptations.rationale: Replace praise with the fact that earns it.

adaptations.sourceSection: Content > Vague attributions and overgeneralization of opinions
adaptations.rationale: Name the source and the proposition it supports.

adaptations.sourceSection: Content > Outline-like conclusions about challenges and future prospects
adaptations.rationale: A conclusion must resolve the work rather than gesture at the future.

adaptations.sourceSection: Language and grammar > High density of AI vocabulary words
adaptations.rationale: Vocabulary is an editorial prompt only. The corpus does not support authorship classification.

adaptations.sourceSection: Language and grammar > Avoidance of basic copulatives (is/are phrases)
adaptations.rationale: Prefer the plain verb when the substitute adds nothing.

adaptations.sourceSection: Language and grammar > Negative parallelisms
adaptations.rationale: Test contrast pairs for a fabricated or redundant half.

adaptations.sourceSection: Language and grammar > Lexical diversity/elegant variation
adaptations.rationale: Repeat the exact noun when precision matters.

adaptations.sourceSection: Style > Title case
adaptations.rationale: Project profiles decide heading case. Headings can be protected from generic analysis.

adaptations.sourceSection: Style > Overuse of boldface; Inline-header vertical lists; Overuse of em dashes; Emoji as formatting; Unusual use of tables
adaptations.rationale: Each mechanic remains profile-scoped. Tables and quoted material are protected by default in editorial profiles.

adaptations.sourceSection: Communication intended for the user > Collaborative communication
adaptations.rationale: Remove interface language that escaped into the document.

adaptations.sourceSection: Communication intended for the user > Knowledge-cutoff disclaimers and speculation about gaps in sources
adaptations.rationale: Treat these as contamination, not style.

adaptations.sourceSection: Communication intended for the user > Phrasal templates and placeholder text
adaptations.rationale: Unfilled drafting tokens are mechanical defects.

adaptations.sourceSection: Markup > Internal formatting and reference markup bugs
adaptations.rationale: Tool-specific citation tokens are mechanical contamination.

adaptations.sourceSection: Citations > utm_source=
adaptations.rationale: Remove AI-tool tracking parameters without rewriting the link text.

adaptations.sourceSection: P13: Subjectless fragments and agentless passives
adaptations.rationale: Scoped away from changelogs and documentation where fragments are conventional.

adaptations.sourceSection: P30: Diff-anchored writing
adaptations.rationale: Version-scoped documents remain an explicit exception.

adaptations.sourceSection: P31: Manufactured punchlines and staccato drama
adaptations.rationale: One short landing can work. A repeated reveal cadence is the target.

adaptations.sourceSection: P32: Aphorism formulas
adaptations.rationale: Quoted and established formulations remain protected.

adaptations.sourceSection: Personality and soul
adaptations.rationale: A sterile rewrite fails even when every negative flag disappears.
